_comment: WF-V6 per-subject turnaround contract (scripts/v6/README.md). Vehicle author frame: nose +z, near flank +x, y up, ground y = 0, x and z centred. Views: GPT turnaround of the concept; front / rear / top regenerated 2026-09-27 after the setup audit (turnaround/README.md; the first set is in ../turnaround-0-drifted). No regions.json: families.table = flat colours sampled (median clusters) off the concept; families.body names the body family.
_note: 2026-09-27: turnaround regenerated (Gemini sheet + repairs, scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs; the previous GPT set is ../turnaround-1-gpt); per-view shift / scale / drift / holes measured on the previous images are not carried over — re-measure them on these images at the setup audit. Dropped (measured on the previous images): none present.

families._spanOpen: 2026-09-28 (scripts/v6/README.md 'Span opening'): the x / z body spans are counted on the body mask opened with a 2 x 2 square, so the 1-px anti-alias halo columns / rows of dark outlines (mirror heads, lamps: greys classified as body) no longer widen W / L; setup auditors 2026-09-28
families._enclosedFg: off: no white parts (lamps are pale yellow, the grab bar / mirror brackets enclose see-through white loops)
families._body: body = the cab + refuse-body green; the rear-loader hopper (darker green) and its loading mouth are their own families, so the side / top body span (L, z origin) runs from the cab nose to the hopper's green front frame. The concept draws the cab WIDER than the refuse body (cab ~1.13 x): the widest green is the cab in the front / rear views and the cab / body in the top view, so the W anchor (2.5 m) is their mean and the W residuals (front +3.7 %, rear +0.4 %, top -4.1 %) are that design, not drift
families._viewTable: 2026-09-27: per-view colours of the families (scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs families --apply; out/turnaround/garbage_truck/families.proposal.json): each view's foreground colour clusters (>= 1 %) matched to the table's families with ONE per-view colour offset (side +5.8 +2.4 +4.9 · front +4.9 -0.6 +5 · rear +6.8 -6.5 +6.6 · top +7.5 +3.6 +5.8); ambiguous: rear #303537 3.7 % dark (vs mouth); rear #30562c 2.2 % hopper (vs body); rear #9baaba 2.1 % glass (vs bumper); rear #474c4c 1.1 % hopper (vs dark); top #3c6c37 2.4 % body (vs hopper); top #1a2e1a 2.2 % mouth (vs dark); top #9eb2bd 1.1 % glass (vs bumper). Measured on these images: turnaround.mjs re-derives it for any other image set and install writes it for the installed one.

rear.why: S2 ruled drift (above the mirror head): no cab flank strip outside the body (body outer x 367..657 = 2.47 m, nothing beyond); at cab 2.65 > body 2.35 the model's cab shows 0.15 m per side outside the body, x 356..374 here (up ~0.65..3.0)
S2, same strip below the mirror head (y 423..500 left out: the mirror head with its rearward glass stays)

S2, near flank: the body's rounded-edge band y 643..669 vs the model's body edge at y 655
S2: the cab's far flank (outline y 372, core 389) is drawn 2.49 m outer / 2.08 m core; the ruled cab 2.65 m puts the model's cab edge at y 361 over background
S2: the cab's near flank (outline y 665) vs the model's cab edge at y 672 over background

concept.why: front bumper's far end at x 64 is 0.28 m proud of the cab's far edge (x 87) while the near end (x 300) is flush with the cab's near edge; the front view has it 0.07 m proud per side (bumper r +-1.16 vs cab +-1.09)

the cab face fans: far vertical edge 212 px (y 448-660) vs near edge 240 px (y 512-752); the roof's front edge slopes 0.30 (64/213 px) where the x axis projects at 0.46 and the bumper line at 0.43, so the far roof corner sits ~0.2 m too low; the front view's cab face is a rectangle (up 0.65..2.635)
